title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Tuesday, 3 November 2026
description: Abu Dhabi signs four AI deals with OpenAI in a push to become an AI-native government, the RBA board meets today with a rate rise widely expected, Queensland remains the only holdout on the national Thriving Kids disability program, and the Gold Coast council drops its fight against the Oxenford quarry expansion. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
